formula_or_test: SPFM ≥ threshold, where SPFM = 1 − (Σλ_SPF + Σλ_RF) / Σλ_total; thresholds: ASIL B ≥ 90%, ASIL C ≥ 97%, ASIL D ≥ 99%; no SPFM requirement for ASIL A
inputs: λ_total: total failure rate of component
authority: ISO 26262:2018, Part 5 — Product development at the hardware level
volatility: low — unchanged between 2011 and 2018 editions of Part 5, though clause numbering shifted

formula_or_test: LFM ≥ threshold, where LFM = 1 − Σλ_RF / (Σλ_total − Σλ_SPF − Σλ_RF); thresholds: ASIL B ≥ 60%, ASIL C ≥ 80%, ASIL D ≥ 90%; no LFM requirement for ASIL A
inputs: λ_total: total failure rate of component
authority: ISO 26262:2018, Part 5 — Product development at the hardware level
volatility: low — unchanged between 2011 and 2018 editions of Part 5, though clause numbering shifted

formula_or_test: PMHF < target, where PMHF = Σλ_SPF + Σλ_RF + Σ[λ_DP × (ratio_DP_d + ratio_DP_L)]; targets: ASIL A < 10⁻⁶/hr, ASIL B < 10⁻⁷/hr, ASIL C < 10⁻⁷/hr, ASIL D < 10⁻⁸/hr
authority: ISO 26262:2018, Part 5 — Product development at the hardware level
clause_locator: Table 6 or Table 7 (PMHF targets per ASIL); Annex A or B (PMHF calculation formula)

formula_or_test: FIT = failures / (10⁹ device-hours); equivalently, FIT = 10⁹ / MTBF_hours, where MTBF = total device-hours / number of failures
authority: JEDEC JESD85 — Methods for Calculating Failure Rates in Units of FITs
volatility: low — the FIT definition is stable across JEDEC revisions

calculation: Arrhenius thermal acceleration factor for semiconductor reliability testing
formula_or_test: AF = exp[(Ea/k) × (1/T_use − 1/T_test)], where Ea is activation energy, k is Boltzmann constant (8.617 × 10⁻⁵ eV/K), T_use and T_test are absolute temperatures in Kelvin; common Ea values: ~0.7–0.9 eV for electromigration, ~0.3 eV for oxide defects
authority: JEDEC JEP122 — Failure Mechanisms and Models for Silicon Semiconductor Devices
volatility: low — Arrhenius model and typical Ea values are stable across editions; specific Ea values for each mechanism may be updated as new data emerges

formula_or_test: tREFI = 64ms / N_rows; DDR2/DDR3: 64ms / 8192 rows = 7.8125μs per row; DDR4: 64ms / 8192 = 7.8125μs (with 1X refresh) or 3.906μs (with 2X refresh at extended temperature); DDR5: 64ms / 64K rows
inputs: N_rows: number of rows per bank (JEDEC-specified per generation)
tREFI_max: maximum refresh interval (64ms standard temperature, 32ms extended temperature)
authority: JEDEC DDR SDRAM specifications: JESD79-2F (DDR2), JESD79-4C (DDR3), JESD79-4B (DDR4)
volatility: low per generation — values fixed at spec release; DDR4 added 2X refresh option

formula_or_test: T_J = T_A + P_D × Rθ_JA, where T_J is junction temperature, T_A is ambient temperature, P_D is power dissipation, and Rθ_JA is junction-to-ambient thermal resistance
inputs: P_D: device power dissipation in watts
Rθ_JA: junction-to-ambient thermal resistance in °C/W (characterized per JEDEC JESD51)
authority: JEDEC JESD51 series (thermal measurement methodology); also commonly referenced in ANSI/JEDEC standards for IC thermal characterization
volatility: low — the formula is basic thermal physics; Rθ_JA measurement methodology in JESD51 is stable

calculation: CHIPS Act advanced manufacturing investment tax credit
formula_or_test: Tax credit = 25% of qualified investment in an advanced manufacturing facility, applied against federal income tax; facility must be primarily for semiconductor manufacturing or semiconductor equipment manufacturing
inputs: qualified investment amount in the facility
authority: CHIPS and Science Act of 2022, Section 9902 (codified as 26 U.S.C. § 48D — Advanced Manufacturing Investment Credit)
volatility: low — statutory percentage; implementation details in Treasury/IRS rulemaking may evolve

formula_or_test: Recipient of CHIPS Act incentives shall not make any significant transaction involving material expansion of semiconductor manufacturing capacity in a country of concern during a 10-year period; 'significant transaction' defined with threshold values for different semiconductor types (logic, DRAM, NAND)
authority: CHIPS and Science Act of 2022, Section 9902, subsection (d) (guardrails provisions); further defined in Commerce Department Final Rule
volatility: moderate — statutory text fixed, but Commerce Department threshold definitions may be updated through rulemaking

calculation: US Export Control ECCN 3A090 classification for advanced computing ICs
formula_or_test: An integrated circuit is classified under ECCN 3A090 if it has either: total processing performance (TPP) meeting or exceeding a controlled threshold, OR interconnect bandwidth meeting or exceeding a controlled threshold (thresholds differ for PRC/non-PRC destinations and changed between Oct 2022 and Oct 2023 BIS rules); also applies to items meeting certain adjusted peak performance (APP) thresholds
inputs: total processing performance in TOPS or TPP equivalent
date of shipment (determines which version of threshold applies)
authority: US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), 15 CFR Part 736 et seq.; Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) Advanced Computing and Semiconductor Export Controls rules (Oct 7, 2022; Oct 17, 2023; various updates)
clause_locator: ECCN 3A090 in Commerce Control List Supplement No. 1 to Part 774
volatility: high — thresholds and classification criteria have been updated multiple times since October 2022; further revisions expected

calculation: JEDEC wafer-level reliability lot sample size for HTOL qualification
formula_or_test: Standard HTOL qualification: minimum 77 device-hours accumulated across 3 lots with ≥231 total device-hours to demonstrate ≤10% failure rate at 60% confidence; specific sampling plans defined per JEDEC or customer-specific requirements
inputs: target confidence level and allowable failure rate
authority: JEDEC JESD47 — Stress-Test-Driven Qualification of Integrated Circuits
volatility: low — sampling requirements are stable across revisions
